# 4. Environment variables

<!-- Generated by `pnpm env:example` from lib/env/index.ts. Edit that file, not this one. -->

Environment variables are settings the site needs but that must not live in the code: passwords, tokens and
addresses that differ between stores. You set them in two places:

- **On Vercel** (the live site and previews): Vercel → your project → **Settings → Environment Variables**.
  Each variable can apply to **Production** (the live site), **Preview** (the test links on pull requests) and
  **Development** (`vercel env pull` for local work). The table says which ones to tick.
- **On your computer** (only if you run the site locally): in a file called `.env.local`. Copy `.env.example` to
  `.env.local` and replace each `__REPLACE_ME__`.

**Secret** values are passwords: never paste them into chat, issues or code. **Public** values end up in the
browser and are safe to share. After changing a variable on Vercel, redeploy for it to take effect.

Check what is set with `pnpm env:check` (✅ set, ➖ optional and empty, ❌ missing or wrong).
If required values are missing, `pnpm dev` shows a setup page listing them, and Vercel builds stop with the same list.

## Site

| Variable               | What it's for                                                                    | Where to get it                                                                                                                        | Needed?  | Type   | Vercel environments |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------ | ------------------- |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` | Public address of the store, used for canonical links, sitemap and webhook URLs. | Your domain in Vercel → Project → Domains. Leave empty to use the Vercel production domain. ([guide](https://vercel.com/docs/domains)) | Optional | Public | Production          |

## Shopify Storefront

| Variable                                      | What it's for                                                        | Where to get it                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Needed?      | Type   | Vercel environments              |
| --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ------ | -------------------------------- |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN`            | Which Shopify store the site reads products, cart and checkout from. | Shopify admin → Settings → Domains: the your-store.myshopify.com address. ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/building-with-the-storefront-api/getting-started))                                    | **Required** | Public | Production, Preview, Development |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Public token that lets the site read the catalog and manage carts.   | Shopify admin → Sales channels → Headless → your storefront → Storefront API → Public access token. ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/building-with-the-storefront-api/manage-headless-channels)) | **Required** | Public | Production, Preview, Development |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOPIFY_SHOP_ID`                 | Numeric shop ID used by Shopify analytics and checkout.              | Set the store domain and token first, then run `pnpm env:check`: it looks the number up and prints it. ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/building-with-the-storefront-api/getting-started))       | **Required** | Public | Production, Preview, Development |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_ID`           | Headless storefront ID for analytics attribution.                    | Shopify admin → Sales channels → Headless → your storefront (number in the URL).                                                                                                                                       | Optional     | Public | Production, Preview, Development |
| `SHOPIFY_API_VERSION`                         | Overrides the Storefront API version. Leave empty.                   | Only set when a developer asks you to.                                                                                                                                                                                 | Optional     | Public | Production, Preview, Development |

## Shopify webhooks & revalidation

| Variable                 | What it's for                                                                               | Where to get it                                                                                                                                                      | Needed?  | Type   | Vercel environments |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------ | ------------------- |
| `SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Lets the site trust Shopify's change notifications, so edits show up within seconds.        | The client secret of the app that ran `pnpm shopify:setup` (Dev Dashboard → app → Settings). ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/webhooks/subscribe/https)) | Optional | Secret | Production, Preview |
| `REVALIDATE_SECRET`      | Password for refreshing content Shopify sends no notification for (menus, pages, policies). | Make one up: a long random string (for example from a password manager).                                                                                             | Optional | Secret | Production, Preview |

## Customer accounts

| Variable                                     | What it's for                                                                | Where to get it                                                                                                                                                                                     | Needed?                              | Type   | Vercel environments              |
| -------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------ | -------------------------------- |
| `CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SESSION_SECRET`            | Encrypts customer login sessions. Only needed when customer accounts are on. | Make one up: a long random string. It is not a Shopify value. ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/building-with-the-customer-account-api/getting-started))                       | Required if customer accounts are on | Secret | Production, Preview, Development |
| `SHOPIFY_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_API_CLIENT_ID`     | Identifies the store to Shopify's customer login.                            | Shopify admin → Sales channels → Headless → your storefront → Customer Account API. ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/building-with-the-customer-account-api/getting-started)) | Required if customer accounts are on | Secret | Production, Preview, Development |
| `SHOPIFY_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_API_CLIENT_SECRET` | Secret for Shopify's customer login.                                         | Same screen as the client ID. ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/building-with-the-customer-account-api/getting-started))                                                       | Required if customer accounts are on | Secret | Production, Preview, Development |

## Shopify Admin (setup script only)

| Variable                         | What it's for                                                                 | Where to get it                                                                                                                                                                                       | Needed?  | Type   | Vercel environments |
| -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------ | ------------------- |
| `SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN`           | Store the setup script changes. Defaults to NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN. | your-store.myshopify.com. Only in .env.local on the computer that runs setup.                                                                                                                         | Optional | Public | Don't set on Vercel |
| `SHOPIFY_ADMIN_API_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Admin API token for `pnpm shopify:setup`. Never needed by the live site.      | See docs/03-setting-up-a-new-store.md → Admin API access. Or use the client ID and secret below. ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization/client-credentials-grant)) | Optional | Secret | Don't set on Vercel |
| `SHOPIFY_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID`        | Dev Dashboard app client ID; setup exchanges it for a 24-hour Admin token.    | Shopify Dev Dashboard → your app → Settings. ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization/client-credentials-grant))                                                     | Optional | Public | Don't set on Vercel |
| `SHOPIFY_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET`    | Dev Dashboard app client secret (pairs with the client ID).                   | Shopify Dev Dashboard → your app → Settings. ([guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization/client-credentials-grant))                                                     | Optional | Secret | Don't set on Vercel |
| `SHOPIFY_ADMIN_API_VERSION`      | Admin API version the setup script uses (default 2026-10).                    | Leave empty unless a developer asks you to change it.                                                                                                                                                 | Optional | Public | Don't set on Vercel |

## Analytics

| Variable                         | What it's for                                                                      | Where to get it                                                                                                                            | Needed?  | Type   | Vercel environments |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------ | ------------------- |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_META_PIXEL_ID`      | Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Pixel for ads measurement. Loads only on the live site.  | Meta Events Manager → Data sources → your Pixel → ID. ([guide](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/952192354843755))                    | Optional | Public | Production          |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID` | Google Analytics 4 measurement. Loads only on the live site.                       | Google Analytics → Admin → Data streams → your web stream → Measurement ID. ([guide](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9539598)) | Optional | Public | Production          |
| `ANALYTICS_FORCE_ENABLE`         | Set to "true" to test Pixel/GA4 outside production. Never set it in Production.    | Only for testing tracking locally or on one preview.                                                                                       | Optional | Public | Development         |
| `META_CAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN`         | Reserved for a future server-side Meta Conversions API. Not read yet; leave empty. | See docs/maintainers/roadmap.md.                                                                                                           | Optional | Secret | Don't set on Vercel |

## Agent & bot protection (dormant)

| Variable                | What it's for                                                     | Where to get it                                                | Needed?  | Type   | Vercel environments |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------ | ------------------- |
| `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`    | Model access for the Shop Agent (features.agent). Off by default. | Vercel → AI Gateway. Only when a developer turns the agent on. | Optional | Secret | Don't set on Vercel |
| `UCP_AGENT_PROFILE_URL` | Override for the Shop Agent's public profile. Leave empty.        | Only when a developer turns the agent on.                      | Optional | Public | Don't set on Vercel |
| `EVE_DEV`               | Set automatically by the agent's dev command. Leave empty.        | Never set by hand.                                             | Optional | Public | Don't set on Vercel |

## Debugging

| Variable        | What it's for                                          | Where to get it                               | Needed?  | Type   | Vercel environments |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------ | ------------------- |
| `DEBUG_SHOPIFY` | Set to "1" to log how long each Shopify request takes. | Only while a developer investigates slowness. | Optional | Public | Development         |

## Set by Vercel automatically

`VERCEL_ENV` (production, preview or development) and `VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL` come from Vercel. Never set
them yourself. Marketing tracking (Meta Pixel, GA4) only loads when `VERCEL_ENV` is `production`.
